ThermaVibe is independently owned and operated, founded on more than 40 years of nursing experience. With a Doctorate in Nursing Practice, an MBA in Healthcare Management, and additional training in natural healing, red light therapy, and other wellness modalities, I have spent my career caring for people physically, mentally, and emotionally.

ThermaVibe was born from that experience and passion. After decades of helping others feel their best, I created a trusted destination for quality recovery and wellness products that bring effective at-home wellness within reach.

From barrel and infrared saunas to cold plunges, massage chairs, and salt therapy solutions, every product we carry is chosen for its superior craftsmanship and lasting durability. The result is a personal wellness retreat that fits seamlessly into your everyday life.
https://thermavibe.com here to meet your wellness needs.
